title: Active Liquidity Management, Strategic Complementarities, and Market Price of Liquidity
near_miss_reason: Table 6 (2003 mutual-fund scandal) is a staggered binary design (event = 1 from the month a fund family's illegal trading became public; announcement months Sep 2003 to Mar 2004) with fund and year-month FE, but every column also includes preevent (scandal fund x after Sep 2003 but before the family's own announcement), an extra treatment regressor defined from a common date, plus time-varying fund controls (volatility beta, lagged alpha, lagged expense ratio, log lagged TNA). Columns 4-5 are IV. The extra-treatment violation keeps it out of the 5c controls analysis as well, and the package ships only mock data.
eligible_reason: Main identification of the paper is a fund-month panel regression of active liquidity management on market volatility (continuous regressor) with fund and time FE; not a DiD. The only binary staggered treatment is the scandal-revelation indicator in Table 6 (and Table 7 interactions), and no reported column satisfies the rules: preevent and time-varying controls appear in all columns, columns 4-5 are 2SLS (event instruments flows), Table 7 interacts event with within-fund illiquidity rank quartiles and absorbs fund-stock, fund-ym, stock-ym FE. Data are proprietary (Morningstar, CRSP, 13F) and the package ships randomized mock datasets with made-up identifiers and dates.
design_notes: PreparationScandalFunds.do: hand-collected scandal fund list (StataBib/ScandalFundsList.dta, NonMatchedScandalFundsList.dta; 17 fund families) with family-level announcement dates; sym = announcement month; sample ym 512-541 (Sep 2002 to Feb 2005); event = 1 if ym >= sym, set to missing for ym >= sym+12; preevent = 1 if ym in [Sep 2003, sym). Announcement months in the list: Sep 2003 (most), Oct, Nov, Dec 2003, Jan, Feb, Mar 2004 (7 cohorts). Table 6: reghdfe z(flows | ALMgmt | ALMgmt+Cash) event preevent zvw_volbeta zlag_alpha4 zlag_expense zloglag_tna, abs(fundid ym) cluster(fundid ym); N = 10,091, 694 funds (LogFiles/Table_6.txt). Columns 4-5: ivreghdfe with flows instrumented by event. Tables 1-5, 8, IA tables: reghdfe of ALMgmt or flows on continuous volatility measures with fund and year/quarter FE and controls. Table 9: stock-level reversal returns on fragility interactions. Figure IA1: event-window regressions around volatility spikes with high-fragility interactions.
